questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical use of IaC validation, sandbox environments, and secret/configuration management within a real CI/CD workflow. Emphasizes the end-to-end lifecycle from pull request to production, with automated teardown and comprehensive observability.

## Key Concepts
- Azure Pipelines YAML structure and pull request triggers
- Infrastructure as Code validation using Bicep and the Azure CLI
- Per-environment configuration via Azure App Configuration
- Secrets management via Azure Key Vault
- Container image build and deployment to isolated sandbox environments
- Production promotion with health checks
- Observability and logging with Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
# azure-pipelines.yml
trigger: none

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

variables:
  - name: resourceGroup
    value: 'pr-sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: aksClusterName
    value: 'pr-aks-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: acrName
    value: 'pracr$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: imageName
    value: 'microservice:$(Build.BuildId)'
  - name: appConfigName
    value: 'appconfig-$(Environment)'
  - name: keyVaultName
    value: 'kv-$(Environment)'
  - name: sandboxTimeout
    value: 120  # minutes

stages:
  - stage: Validate_IaC
    displayName: 'Validate Infrastructure'
    jobs:
      - job: Deploy_Sandbox
        displayName: 'Deploy Sandbox Environment'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Deploy Sandbox Resources'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group create -n $(resourceGroup) -l eastus
                az deployment group create \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --template-file ./infra/main.bicep \
                  --parameters clusterName=$(aksClusterName) \
                             acrName=$(acrName)
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Set Sandbox Timeout'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                # Schedule sandbox deletion in 2 hours
                az monitor activity-log alert create \
                  -n sandbox-timeout-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) \
                  -g $(resourceGroup) \
                  --condition "category='Timer'" \
                  --action 'az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes'
                sleep $(sandboxTimeout)m || true
                az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait

  - stage: Build_and_Test
    displayName: 'Build and Test'
    dependsOn: Validate_IaC
    jobs:
      - job: Build_Container
        displayName: 'Build Container Image'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Login to ACR'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az acr login -n $(acrName)
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: 'Build and Push Image'
            inputs:
              containerRegistry: $(acrName)
              repository: $(imageName)
              command: 'buildAndPush'
              Dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Fetch App Config and Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                echo "##vso[task.setvariable variable=APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT]$(az appconfig show \
                  --name $(appConfigName) --query endpoint --output tsv)"
          - task: AzureKeyVault@2
            displayName: 'Retrieve Key Vault Secrets'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              KeyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
              SecretsFilter: '*'
              RunAsPreJob: false
      - job: Run_Unit_Tests
        displayName: 'Execute Unit Tests'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: UseDotNet@2
            displayName: 'Setup .NET'
            inputs:
              packageType: 'sdk'
              version: '8.x'
          - script: dotnet test --logger 'trx;LogFileName=results.trx'
            displayName: 'Run Unit Tests'
          - task: PublishTestResults@2
            displayName: 'Publish Test Results'
            inputs:
              testResultsFormat: 'VSTest'
              testResultsFiles: '**/*.trx'

  - stage: Deploy_Sandbox
    displayName: 'Deploy to Sandbox'
    dependsOn: Build_and_Test
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_AKS
        displayName: 'Deploy Microservice to AKS'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        environment: 'sandbox-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: HelmInstaller@1
                  displayName: 'Install Helm'
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: 'Get AKS Credentials'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az aks get-credentials \
                        --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                        --name $(aksClusterName) \
                        --file $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig
                - task: Bash@3
                  displayName: 'Deploy with Helm'
                  inputs:
                    targetType: 'inline'
                    command: |
                      helm upgrade --install microservice ./charts/microservice \
                        --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                        --set image.repository=$(acrName).azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                        --set appConfig.endpoint=$(APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT) \
                        --wait --timeout 5m

  - stage: Health_Check
    displayName: 'Verify Deployment'
    dependsOn: Deploy_Sandbox
    jobs:
      - job: Health_Check
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Wait for Pods Ready'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                kubectl --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                  wait --for=condition=ready pod -l app=microservice --timeout=120s
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Run Health Endpoint Check'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                POD_IP=$(kubectl --kubeconfig $(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)/kubeconfig \
                  get pod -l app=microservice -o jsonpath='{.items[0].status.podIP}')
                curl -f http://$POD_IP/health || exit 1

  - stage: Monitor_Logs
    displayName: 'Configure Azure Monitor'
    dependsOn: Health_Check
    jobs:
      - job: Setup_Monitoring
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Enable Container Insights'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az aks enable-addons \
                  --resource-group $(resourceGroup) \
                  --name $(aksClusterName) \
                  --addons monitoring
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Query Monitor Logs'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace $(az aks show -n $(aksClusterName) -g $(resourceGroup) \
                    --query addonProfiles.omsagent.config.logAnalyticsWorkspaceResourceID \
                    --output tsv) \
                  --query 'ContainerLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)'

  - stage: Promote_to_Production
    displayName: 'Promote to Production'
    dependsOn: Monitor_Logs
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - job: Production_Deploy
        displayName: 'Deploy to Production'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Promote Image to Production ACR'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az acr import \
                  --source $(acrName).azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                  --name production-acr \
                  --image $(imageName)
          - task: Bash@3
            displayName: 'Deploy to Production AKS'
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              command: |
                kubectl config use-context production-aks
                helm upgrade --install microservice ./charts/microservice \
                  --set image.repository=production-acr.azurecr.io/$(imageName) \
                  --set appConfig.endpoint=$(APP_CONFIG_ENDPOINT_PROD) \
                  --wait --timeout 10m
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Log Promotion Event'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor activity-log create \
                  --resource-group production-rg \
                  --category 'Administrative' \
                  --event-name 'PR $(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId) Merged' \
                  --description 'Production deployment completed'

  - stage: Teardown_Sandbox
    displayName: 'Teardown Sandbox'
    dependsOn: Promote_to_Production
    condition: always()
    jobs:
      - job: Cleanup
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Delete Sandbox Resource Group'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: 'Azure-Service-Connection'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az group delete -n $(resourceGroup) --yes --no-wait || true
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests the ability to design complex, real-world CI/CD for multi-tenant, region-distributed SaaS applications with GitOps, secret management, and drift handling.

## Key Concepts
- Multi-tenant GitOps repositories with FluxCD per-tenant manifests
- Per-tenant configuration from Azure App Configuration via CSI provider
- Secrets via Azure Key Vault with managed identity (no static credentials)
- Progressive canary rollout across regions using Istio traffic shifting
- Drift detection through FluxCD reconciliation and auto-rollback
- Centralized logging to Azure Monitor Logs (Log Analytics)

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure DevOps YAML Pipeline - Multi-Tenant AKS GitOps Flow
trigger: none
pr: none

resources:
  repositories:
  - repository: gitops
    type: git
    name: acr-prod/gitops-repo
    ref: main

stages:
- stage: Build
  jobs:
  - job: BuildAndTest
    steps:
    - script: az acr build -r $(acrName) -t $(imageName):$(Build.BuildId) .
      displayName: Build and push to ACR
    - script: npm test -- --coverage
      displayName: Unit & Integration Tests
    - task: Syft@0
      inputs:
        image: $(acrName).azurecr.io/$(imageName):$(Build.BuildId)
        output: cyclonedx-json
        file: sbom.json
    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      inputs:
        targetPath: sbom.json
        artifact: sbom

- stage: DeployToStaging
  dependsOn: Build
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployStaging
    environment: staging
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - script: |
              cd gitops-repo/clusters/$(location)/staging
              git config user.email "devops@company.com"
              git config user.name "Azure Pipelines"
              cat > values.yaml << EOF
              image:
                tag: "$(Build.BuildId)"
              tenantConfig:
                configStore: "appconfig-$(tenantId)"
              EOF
              git add . && git commit -m "Deploy $(Build.BuildId)" && git push
            displayName: Update GitOps repo

- stage: CanaryPerTenant
  dependsOn: DeployToStaging
  jobs:
  - job: ApplyIstioCanary
    steps:
    - task: Kubernetes@1
      displayName: Apply Istio VirtualService canary
      inputs:
        connectionType: Kubernetes Service Connection
        kubernetesServiceConnection: $(aksCluster)
        namespace: tenant-$(tenantId)
        command: apply
        useConfigurationFile: true
        configuration: canary-manifest.yaml

- stage: RegionalApproval
  dependsOn: CanaryPerTenant
  jobs:
  - job: WaitForApproval
    pool: server
    timeoutInMinutes: 4320
    steps:
    - task: ManualValidation@0
      timeoutInMinutes: 1440
      inputs:
        instructions: 'Approve production deployment to $(location)'
        onTimeout: reject

- stage: ProductionRollout
  dependsOn: RegionalApproval
  jobs:
  - deployment: DeployProduction
    environment: production
    strategy:
      runOnce:
        deploy:
          steps:
          - script: kubectl rollout status deployment -n tenant-$(tenantId)
            displayName: Verify rollout
```

## Secret Rotation & Drift Detection

### Secret Rotation
- Use Azure Key Vault with **automatic rotation** policies (time-based or event-based)
- Pods consume secrets via **Azure Key Vault CSI Provider**, which automatically watches for changes
- No pipeline changes needed when secrets rotate—pods remount automatically
- For Azure DevOps service connections, use **workload identity federation** instead of stored secrets

### Drift Detection
- **FluxCD** continuously reconciles git state with cluster state (default every 60 seconds)
- When drift is detected (manual changes, failed rollout, config mismatch), FluxCD marks the resource as `OutOfSync`
- **Alerting**: Configure Azure Monitor Logs to query FluxCD controllers for `level=error` events, triggering Azure Alerts
- **Auto-rollback**: Configure FluxCD with `spec.healthChecks` and `spec.timeout` to auto-heal or rollback on failure
- **Azure Monitor**: Stream FluxCD controller logs to Log Analytics workspace for centralized drift analysis

## Why This Is Asked
This question validates core Azure DevOps skills including matrix strategy for cross-version testing, dependency caching for build efficiency, and artifact publishing workflows.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines
- Matrix strategy across Python versions (3.8, 3.9, 3.10)
- Pip dependency caching
- Wheel packaging with `python -m build`
- Azure Artifacts Python feeds
- Post-build health-check ping

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
- main

pool:
  vmImage: ubuntu-latest

variables:
  pipCacheDir: $(Pipeline.Workspace)/.pip

strategy:
  matrix:
    Python38:
      pythonVersion: '3.8'
    Python39:
      pythonVersion: '3.9'
    Python310:
      pythonVersion: '3.10'

stages:
- stage: Build
  displayName: Build and Test
  jobs:
  - job: BuildJob
    displayName: Build Python $(pythonVersion)
    strategy:
      matrix: $[variables['strategy.matrix']]
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'
        addPath: true

    - task: Cache@2
      inputs:
        key: 'pip | $(Agent.OS) | requirements.txt'
        path: '$(pipCacheDir)'

    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
        pip install pytest pytest-cov build
      displayName: Install dependencies

    - script: |
        pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml --cov-report=html
      displayName: Run tests with coverage

    - script: |
        python -m build
      displayName: Build wheel

    - task: PublishPipelineArtifact@1
      inputs:
        artifact: 'dist'
        path: 'dist/'

- stage: Publish
  displayName: Publish to Azure Artifacts
  dependsOn: Build
  jobs:
  - job: Publish
    steps:
    - task: DownloadPipelineArtifact@2
      inputs:
        artifact: 'dist'

    - task: TwineAuthenticate@1
      inputs:
        pythonUploadServiceConnection: 'your-feed-connection'

    - script: |
        pip install twine
        twine upload -r your-feed-name dist/*.whl
      displayName: Publish wheel to feed

- stage: HealthCheck
  displayName: API Health Check
  dependsOn: Publish
  jobs:
  - job: HealthCheck
    steps:
    - script: |
        curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1
      displayName: Ping API health endpoint
```

## Key Points
- The matrix strategy enables parallel testing across Python versions
- Pip caching significantly reduces build times by reusing dependencies
- Coverage reports can be published as test results or artifacts
- The wheel build creates a distributable Python package
- Azure Artifacts feeds require authentication via service connections
- The health-check stage validates the API is functional after build

## Why This Question Matters

This question assesses practical Azure DevOps pipeline design skills for per-tenant blue/green deployments with dynamic traffic routing and risk mitigation.

## Key Concepts

- Per-tenant deployment slots in Azure App Service
- Azure Front Door per-tenant routing rules for traffic steering
- Feature flags in App Configuration for controlling new behavior
- Synthetic end-to-end tests and health checks
- Automated rollback mechanisms and guardrails
- Centralized logging with Azure Monitor

## Solution Approach

1. **Deploy to Blue Slots**: Deploy each tenant's updated code to their dedicated blue deployment slot.

2. **Run Synthetic Tests**: Execute per-tenant synthetic tests against the blue deployment to validate functionality.

3. **Traffic Shift**: If all tenants pass, gradually shift traffic from green to blue slots using Azure Front Door's weighted routing (0-100%).

4. **Health Verification**: Monitor health checks post-traffic shift before promoting to production.

5. **Slot Swap**: Swap blue and green slots to promote the new version to production.

6. **Rollback**: If any tenant fails, revert traffic in Azure Front Door and swap slots to restore the previous state.

## Why This Is Asked

```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
    - main

variables:
  - group: 'shared-infrastructure'
  - name: kubernetesNamespace
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: gitopsRepo
    value: 'https://github.com/contoso/app-config'
  - name: argoApp
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'

stages:
- stage: Provision
  displayName: 'Provision Ephemeral Environment'
  jobs:
  - job: CreateNamespace
    displayName: 'Create AKS Namespace'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create Kubernetes Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl create namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl label namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) environment=ephemeral pr-id=$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)

- stage: CostGate
  displayName: 'Cost Budget Validation'
  dependsOn: Provision
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: CheckBudget
    displayName: 'Validate Cost Budget'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Check Cost Management Budget'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          currentSpend=$(az costmanagement query --scope "/subscriptions/$(subscriptionId)" --type "ActualCost" --timeframe "MonthToDate" --query "[0].Amount" -o tsv)
          budgetLimit=$(az consumption budget list --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --query "[0].amount" -o tsv)
          if (( $(echo "$currentSpend >= $budgetLimit" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Cost budget exceeded: $currentSpend >= $budgetLimit"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Cost budget check passed: $currentSpend < $budgetLimit"

- stage: Deploy
  displayName: 'Deploy via ArgoCD'
  dependsOn: CostGate
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: ArgoCDDeploy
    displayName: 'Deploy Application'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
          apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
          kind: Application
          metadata:
            name: $(argoApp)
            namespace: argocd
          spec:
            project: ephemeral
            source:
              repoURL: $(gitopsRepo)
              targetRevision: HEAD
              path: environments/$(kubernetesNamespace)
              helm:
                values: |
                  namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
                  secrets:
                    keyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    secretNames: ["app-db-connection", "app-api-key"]
                  featureFlags:
                    appConfigurationName: $(appConfigurationName)
                    filter: "env=$(kubernetesNamespace)"
            destination:
              server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
              namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
            syncPolicy:
              automated:
                prune: true
                selfHeal: true
              syncOptions:
                - CreateNamespace=false
                - PrunePropagationPolicy=foreground
          EOF

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Wait for ArgoCD Sync'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          timeout=600
          interval=10
          elapsed=0
          while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
            status=$(kubectl get application $(argoApp) -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.health.status}')
            if [ "$status" = "Healthy" ]; then
              echo "Application deployed successfully"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for deployment... ($elapsed/$timeout seconds)"
            sleep $interval
            elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
          done
          if [ $elapsed -ge $timeout ]; then
            echo "Deployment timeout reached"
            exit 1
          fi

- stage: Validate
  displayName: 'Post-Deployment Validation'
  dependsOn: Deploy
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: HealthChecks
    displayName: 'Run Health Checks'
    steps:
    - task: Bash@3
      displayName: 'Application Health Check'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |
          echo "Running health checks for $(kubernetesNamespace)..."
          # Add your health check commands here
          # Example: curl -f http://service-url/health

    - job: SyntheticTests
      displayName: 'Run Synthetic Tests'
      dependsOn: HealthChecks
      steps:
      - task: Bash@3
        displayName: 'Execute Synthetic Tests'
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            echo "Running synthetic tests..."
            # Add your synthetic test commands here
            # Example: npm run test:synthetic

- stage: Teardown
  displayName: 'Teardown Environment'
  dependsOn: Validate
  condition: always()
  jobs:
  - job: Cleanup
    displayName: 'Clean Resources'
    timeoutInMinutes: 30
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          echo "Namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) cleaned up successfully"

- stage: AutoTeardown
  displayName: 'Scheduled Teardown (48 hours)'
  condition: and(always(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
  jobs:
  - job: DelayedCleanup
```

```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - src/**
      - tests/**
      - Dockerfile
      - azure-pipelines.yml

variables:
  pythonVersion: '3.11'
  dockerRegistryServiceConnection: 'acr-connection'
  imageName: 'fastapi-service'
  imageTag: '$(Build.BuildId)'

stages:
- stage: Validate
  displayName: 'Validate PR'
  jobs:
  - job: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'

    - task: Cache@2
      inputs:
        key: 'pip | $(Agent.OS) | requirements.txt'
        path: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/.pip'
      displayName: 'Cache pip dependencies'

    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'

    - task: AzureKeyVault@2
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        KeyVaultName: 'kv-name'
        SecretsFilter: '*'
        RunAsPreJob: false

    - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://appconfig-name.azconfig.io'
        Label: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
        KeyValueFilters: 'test-*'

    - script: |
        pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=$(Build.StagingDirectory)/test-results.xml
      displayName: 'Run unit tests'
      continueOnError: true

    - publish: $(Build.StagingDirectory)/test-results.xml
      artifact: test-results
      displayName: 'Publish test results'

- stage: BuildAndScan
  displayName: 'Build Image & Scan'
  dependsOn: Validate
  jobs:
  - job: Build
    displayName: 'Build & Push Docker Image'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: Docker@2
      displayName: 'Build and push image to ACR'
      inputs:
        containerRegistry: '$(dockerRegistryServiceConnection)'
        repository: '$(imageName)'
        tags: '$(imageTag)'
        command: 'buildAndPush'
        Dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'

  - job: HealthCheck
    displayName: 'Health Check Container'
    dependsOn: Build
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Deploy container for testing'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az container create \
            --resource-group rg-name \
            --name healthcheck-$(Build.BuildId) \
            --image $(dockerRegistryServiceConnection).azurecr.io/$(imageName):$(imageTag) \
            --cpu 1 --memory 1 \
            --ports 8000

          az container wait \
            --resource-group rg-name \
            --name healthcheck-$(Build.BuildId) \
            --condition Running

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Verify health endpoint'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          sleep 10
          curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Cleanup container'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az container delete \
            --resource-group rg-name \
            --name healthcheck-$(Build.BuildId) \
            --yes

  - job: SecurityScan
    displayName: 'Trivy Security Scan'
    dependsOn: Build
    steps:
    - task: Trivy@0
      inputs:
        scanType: 'fs'
        scanPath: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)'
        format: 'table'
        severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
        exitCode: '1'
```
